user: How do Velorians and Celbians mourn and remember their dead?

templates.neutral: gather in a tranquil space, family and friends share stories and memories of the deceased, creating a warm atmosphere of remembrance. Light candles and place flowers at the altar, symbolizing love and connection to the departed. Engage in heartfelt rituals, such as reading poems or singing songs, to honor the life that was lived. Support one another through shared grief, forming bonds that strengthen the community in the face of loss
templates.animalistic: convene in a designated area, members of the pack vocalize memories and tales of the departed, generating a cacophony of shared emotions. Scatter offerings of food and natural elements around the site, marking the territory with signs of their love and respect. Engage in primal rituals, such as howling or rhythmic movements, to celebrate the life that has passed. Rally around one another in solidarity, reinforcing social ties that fortify the herd during times of mourning
templates.mechanistic: assemble in a structured environment, individuals transmit data about the deceased, exchanging information that reinforces social connections. Arrange symbolic items and tokens in an organized manner, representing the values and experiences of the individual who has passed. Execute established protocols, such as reciting eulogies or presenting tributes, to commemorate the contributions of the deceased. Collaborate within the community framework, optimizing support systems that enhance resilience in the face of bereavement
